english: How to boost your immune system against the COVID-19; 1. Stay hydrated - drink 3-4 litres of water daily. 2. Take antioxidant-rich diet - amla, guava, green leafy veggies, spinach, garlic, green tea, peppers, turmeric 3. Exercise 4. Meditation 5. Quality sleep
ekegusii: Enchera yokomenta ogwetanga korwa Covid 19 1.Kanywe amache amange - chilita 3-4 kera rituko 2.Kari chindagera buna amapera, chinyeni chiekegusii, egetunguo saumu, n.k 3.Tarataria omobere 4.Okoiranerera 5.Chitoro chiisaine
kiswahili: Jinsi ya kuimarisha kinga yako dhidi ya COVID-19; 1. Endelea kuwa na maji mwilini - kunywa lita 3-4 za maji kila siku. 2. Chukua lishe yenye vioksidishaji vingi - amla, guava, mboga za majani mabichi, mchicha, kitunguu saumu, chai ya kijani, pilipili hoho, manjano 3. Mazoezi 4. Kutafakari 5. Usingizi bora
dholuo: Kaka inyalo medo teko mar geng'o tuo mar COVID-19; 1. Bed gi pi moromo - metho lita 3-4 mag pi pile ka pile. 2. Kaw chiemo ma nigi antioxidant mang'eny - amla, guava, alode ma nigi oboke, spinach, garlic, green tea, peppers, turmeric 3. Timo gik matego del 4. Paro matut 5. Nindo e yor chuny
somali: Sida loo xoojiyo nidaamka difaaca jirka ee ka dhanka ah COVID-19; 1. Noqo mid qoyan - cab 3-4 litir oo biyo ah maalin kasta. 2. Qaado cunto antioxidant hodan ah - amla, guava, khudradda caleemaha cagaaran, spinach, basasha, shaaha cagaaran, qumbaha, 3. Jimicsi 4. Fadhiga 5. Hurdo tayo leh

english: A small number of vaccinated people may get infected with COVID-19 after vaccination; this is called a breakthrough infection, but they are likely to have milder symptoms than if they were not vaccinated.
ekegusii: Enamba enke ya abanto mbakageire konyora oborwaire bwa Covid 19 magega yokonyora esindani yogwetanga. Eye nigo ekorokwa okoambokerigwa kwobobui, nonya abanto aba bagotwara ebimanyererio ebike kobua bari bataranyora esindani.
kiswahili: Idadi ndogo ya watu waliochanjwa wanaweza kuambukizwa COVID-19 baada ya chanjo; hii inaitwa maambukizi ya mafanikio, lakini kuna uwezekano wa kuwa na dalili ndogo kuliko kama hawakuchanjwa.
dholuo: Kwan matin mar ji moseyudo chanjo nyalo yudo tuo mar COVID-19 bang' yudo chanjo; mano iluongo ni tuo mar breakthrough, to nyalo bedo ni gin gi ranyisi matin moloyo ka dine bed ni ok omigi chanjo.
somali: Tirada yar ee dadka la tallaalay ayaa laga yaabaa inay ku dhacaan COVID-19 tallaalka ka dib; tani waxaa loo yaqaan cudurka horumarinta, laakiin waxay u badan tahay inay la kulmaan calaamado fudud marka loo eego haddii aan la tallaalin.

english: Multiple immunizations are not allowed. One you have been immunized, you are issued with a COVID-19 certificate from the web of the Ministry of Health
ekegusii: Kobetwa chisindani cao ao teancheiri. Ekero kwanyorire esindani, nabo okonyora esatibigeti yao ya COVI-19 korwa ase omtandao o MOH https://portal.health.go.ke

english: I have invoked the public health act after it was declared a pandemic. Thoroughly wash hands and use alcohol based sanitizers. Keep 1-meter distance from a person who is sneezing or coughing. A person who is coughing or sneezing should stay at home and avoid crowds
ekegusii: Natianirie richiko riobochenu bwensekobwatekana nogotangaswa kwegiateko. Esabe amaboko gotumia chisanitaisa. Tenena oboare bwemita eyemo koru ase omonto ogokorora na goasimora. Omonto ogokorora na goasimora nigo agwenerete kobera nyomba, aare nemesangererekano yabanto.
kiswahili: Nimeitisha sheria ya afya ya umma baada ya kutangazwa kuwa janga. Osha mikono vizuri na utumie vitakasa mikono vyenye pombe. Weka umbali wa mita 1 kutoka kwa mtu anayepiga chafya au kukohoa. Mtu anayekohoa au kupiga chafya anapaswa kukaa nyumbani na kuepuka misongamano ya watu.
dholuo: Asetiyo gi chik mar thieth mar oganda bang' kane oland ni en tuwo malandore. Luok lweteni maber kendo iti gi gik ma geng'o tuoche ma nigi kong'o. Bed mita 1 mabor gi ng'at ma ng'ol kata ma ywak. Ng'at ma ywak kata ng'ol onego osik e pacho kendo kik odhi kama ji ng'enyie.
somali: Waxaan ku baaqay sharciga caafimaadka dadweynaha ka dib markii lagu dhawaaqay cudurka faafa. Gacmaha si taxadar leh u maydho oo isticmaal daawooyinka nadiifinta khamriga ku saleysan. ka fogaada 1 mitir qofkii qiiqaya ama qiiqaya. Qofka qiiqaya ama qiiqaya waa inuu guriga joogaa oo ka fogaadaa dadweynaha

ekegusii: Kenya konyora obokongu kobuatia richiko ria Trump rgotenenia obokonyi bwamariogo ya Esosera na Enyamoreo

somali: Kenya waxay la kulantaa xiisad iyada oo amarkii fulinta ee Trump uu ku jarayo bixinta daawooyinka HIV, malaria

english: Launch of fortified maize, soy blend distributed across primary schools to address undernutrition.
ekegusii: Okorentwa kw'ebituma biburukaine esoya kwararigwe chisukuru chia premari erio gokeania oborwaire bwokoborwa afya
kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa mchanganyiko wa mahindi na soya ulioimarishwa umesambazwa katika shule za msingi ili kukabiliana na utapiamlo.
dholuo: Chakruok mar chamo ng'or kod mza ma opong' gi gik mang'eny, kod mza mopong' gi soya ma ipogo e skunde duto mag praimari mondo otiek chandruok mar kech mar chiemo.

english: Announcement encouraging daily consumption of five fruit/veg portions for wellness and disease prevention.
ekegusii: Okoraria kwogosegeta gwa kera rituko, gwokoria amatunda keboikeranu/ching'eni erio kkoba buya kemobere na gotanga amarwaire.
kiswahili: Tangazo la kuhimiza ulaji wa kila siku wa sehemu tano za matunda/mboga kwa ajili ya ustawi na kinga dhidi ya magonjwa.
dholuo: Weche mag lendo majiwo ji mondo ocham olemo/olembe abich e odiechieng' mondo omi gibed gi ngima maber kendo geng'o tuoche.
somali: Ogeysiis lagu dhiirigelinayo isticmaalka maalinlaha ah ee shan qaybood oo midho / khudaar ah si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka iyo ka hortagga cudurrada.

english: Kenya has identified 3 different Covid 19 viruses virus, Omicron; The cabinet secretary Kagwe has disclosed that this was detected among quarantined, but continued travelling
ekegusii: Kenya yaenekirie ebinyinyi bitato ao ao bia Covid-19 Omicron; omowaziri bwoborwaria CS Kagwe otebire nigo biarorekanete ase abanto barenge chisafari abare babekire karantini.

english: Mombasa Covid-19 Booths: Contactless testing booths to be distributed in 6 constituencies. Booths have zero contact between the medic and patient. Contactless booths allow for safer, faster mass testing. The locally assembled booths are a game changer
ekegusii: Ebisa bia Mombasa Covid-19: Ebisa biogopimwa otarigokunwa nkoenanu bire ase amajimbo 6 y'obochori. Ebisa tibibwati gokunana konde gwonsi gati y'omonyagitari amo n'omorwaire. Ebisa ebi nigo bigoachera ogopimwa kobwate oborendi naende kwa bwango na obonge. Ebisa ebi biroseiri ime y'ensemo eyuo biaonchorire egosori.
kiswahili: Vibanda vya Mombasa Covid-19: Vibanda vya kupima bila kugusa vitasambazwa katika majimbo 6 ya uchaguzi. Vibanda havina mguso wowote kati ya daktari na mgonjwa. Vibanda visivyogusa vinaruhusu upimaji salama na wa haraka wa wingi. Vibanda vilivyokusanyika ndani ya eneo husika vinabadilisha mchezo.
dholuo: Mombasa Covid-19 Booths: Kembe mag pimo ma ok ochom gi ng'ato ibiro pog e kidienje auchiel. Kuondego onge tudruok moro amora e kind laktar kod jatuwo. Kuonde ma ok nyal tudore gi ng'ato, konyo e timo nonro mang'eny e yo mapiyo kendo maonge hinyruok. Sanduge molos e alworawa kelo lokruok maduong' ahinya
somali: Mombasa COVID-19 Booths: Goobaha tijaabada ah ee aan xiriir laheyn ayaa lagu qaybin doonaa 6 goobood. Goobaha tijaabada ah waxay leeyihiin xiriir eber u dhexeeya dhakhtarka iyo bukaanka. Goobaha tijaabada ah ee aan xiriir laheyn waxay u oggolaanayaan tijaabooyin badan oo ammaan ah oo dhakhso badan. Goobaha tijaabada ah ee lagu soo ururiyay deegaanka ayaa beddelaya ciyaarta

english: Over 80% of patients are asymptomatic and can be treated from home. MoH has completed process of home-based care protocols. I appeal to Kenyans, that when we release the protocols and we see people coming home, there is no need for stigmatization
ekegusii: Abarwairengoetania 80% mbabwati biorokererio naende nabo bakorwarigwa bagende chinka. Ewizara y'Oborwari yakorire korosia amachiko y'obokonyi bwa inka. Nigo nkobasaba abakenya, ekero torarwe omoroberio oyo naende torore abanto bakoirana inka, titobachecheria.
kiswahili: Zaidi ya 80% ya wagonjwa hawana dalili na wanaweza kutibiwa nyumbani. Wizara ya Afya imekamilisha mchakato wa itifaki za utunzaji wa nyumbani. Ninawasihi Wakenya, kwamba tunapotoa itifaki hizo na tunaona watu wakirudi nyumbani, hakuna haja ya unyanyapaa.
dholuo: Maloyo 80% mag jotuo onge gi ranyisi kendo inyalo thiedhogi e pacho. Migawo mar Weche Thieth osetieko chenro mag thieth e pacho. Akwayo jo Kenya, ni ka waweyo chike mag thieth kendo waneno ka ji duogo pacho, onge tiende mar chayo ji
somali: In ka badan 80% bukaanka ayaa calaamado la'aan ah waxaana laga daaweyn karaa guriga. Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa dhameystirtay nidaamyada daryeelka guriga ku saleysan. Waxaan ugu baaqayaa dadka Kenya in marka aan sii dayno nidaamyada oo aan aragno dadka guriga imanaya, aysan jirin baahi loo qabo in la calaamadeeyo

english: Govt kicks of distribution of mosquito nets. Govt aims at distributing 15.3M treated nets
ekegusii: Eserekali yang'eire koenana chineti. Eserekali nigo erengete koenana chineti chirwariri 15.3M
kiswahili: Serikali yazindua usambazaji wa vyandarua. Serikali inalenga kusambaza vyandarua milioni 15.3 vilivyotibiwa
dholuo: Sirkal chako pogo net mag kwiri. Sirkal dwaro ni opog ne ji net milion 15.3 mosetigo
somali: Dowladda waxay bilaabaneysaa qaybinta shabagyada cayayaanka. Dowladda waxay higsaneysaa in loo qaybiyo 15.3M shabagyada la daaweeyey

english: Malaria vaccine advisory: More children in malaria endemic counties to be vaccinated. WHO has given an approval for expanded use of the vaccine. 275,000 children partially jabbed, 45,000 are fully vaccinated. Data shows the number of malaria cases has gone down
ekegusii: Obosemia bwa esindani ya Malaria: Abana abange ase chikaunti chikunire na malaria mbanyore esindani. WHO yaetirie ogotumeka mono gwesindani eyuo. Abana 275,000 babetirwe ake, 45,000 babetirwe yonsi. Data yaorokirie ing'a malaria yakeire.
kiswahili: Ushauri wa chanjo ya malaria: Watoto zaidi katika kaunti zilizoathiriwa na malaria watachanjwa. WHO imetoa idhini ya matumizi ya chanjo hiyo kwa upana zaidi. Watoto 275,000 wachapwa sehemu, 45,000 wamechanjwa kikamilifu. Data inaonyesha idadi ya visa vya malaria imepungua
dholuo: Giko mar chanjo mar malaria: Nyithindo mang'eny e gwenge ma malaria opong'o ibiro chanjo. WHO osechiwo thuolo mar tiyo gi chanjo mar Corona e okang' momedore. Nyithindo 275,000 osemi chanjo mar Corona e okang' matin, kendo nyithindo 45,000 osemi chanjo mar Corona chuth. Nonro nyiso ni kwan mar joma nigi malaria osedok chien
somali: Talo-bixinta tallaalka Malaria: Caruur badan oo ku nool degmooyinka dalalka dalalka kala duwan ayaa la tallaali doonaa. WHO ayaa ogolaatay in la ballaariyo isticmaalka tallaalka. 275,000 oo caruur ah ayaa qayb ahaan la tallaalay, 45,000 oo caruur ah ayaa si buuxda loo tallaalay. Xogta ayaa muujineysa in tirada kiisaska malaria ay hoos u dhacday

english: When we open up and talk about what is affecting our mental health, those issues become bearable. They become less distressing, less overwhelming and less worrying. Reach out to us on 1199 and we will be there for you.
ekegusii: Ekero tokoigoka twakwana igoro y'ebinto bigochanga afya y'amongo aito, ching'ana echi nigo chikogusua. Nigo chigotiga goichania, tichiri koritoa naende tichirigotwara omoichano omonge. KWana n aintwe ase 1199 naintwe ntweariganie ase eng'encho yao.
kiswahili: Tunapofungua na kuzungumzia kinachoathiri afya yetu ya akili, masuala hayo yanakuwa rahisi kuyavumilia. Yanakuwa hayana usumbufu mwingi, hayalemei sana na hayana wasiwasi mwingi. Wasiliana nasi kwa 1199 nasi tutakuwepo kwa ajili yako.
dholuo: Sama wawuoyo ayanga kuom gima chando pachwa, wanyalo nyagore gi chandruogego e yo maber. Chandruogego bedo matin, ok gibed madongo ahinya, kendo ok gibed gi parruok mang'eny. Tudri kodwa e 1199 mondo wayud konyruok.
somali: Marka aan furno oo aan ka wada hadalno waxa saameynaya caafimaadka maskaxdeena, arrimahan waxay noqdaan kuwo la dulqaadan karo. Waxay noqdaan kuwo ka yar dhibta, ka yar dhib iyo ka yar welwel. Nala soo xiriir lambarka 1199 waxaanan kuu caawin doonnaa.

english: Definitition of schizophrenia,causes,symptoms,diagnostic tools and treatment.
ekegusii: Eng'encho ya skizofrenia, egekorenta, ebimanyererio, ebifaa biokorenga amo na oborwaria.
kiswahili: Ufafanuzi wa skizofrenia, sababu, dalili, vifaa vya uchunguzi na matibabu.
dholuo: Tiend schizophrenia, gik makelo, ranyisi mag tuono, yore mag fwenyo tuo kod thieth.

english: Techniques like deep breathing,walking or time outdoors are universal tools for managing daily stressors.
ekegusii: Chingencho buna koeyana mono, gotara gose kobuta isiko n'ebikoreri biogotenenera ebirengererio bia kera rituko.
kiswahili: Mbinu kama vile kupumua kwa kina, kutembea au kutumia muda nje ni zana zinazotumika kwa wote katika kudhibiti msongo wa mawazo wa kila siku.
dholuo: Yore kaka yueyo matut, wuotho, kata bedo oko, gin yore ma ji duto tiyogo e loyo parruok ma pile.

ekegusii: Ebiorokererio bia Afya y'obongo buna ebirengererio nabo bikorenta ebimanyererio bia kemobere buna omoroso na oborwaire, na igo kworokia okobwatana gati ya obongo na omobere.

dholuo: Kenya nyiso ni nitie ji 12 kendo ma nigi COVID-19 mamiyo kwan duto mar jogo omedore nyaka 246. Jatend migao mar thieth miluongo ni Mutahi Kagwe wacho ni abich kuomgi gin jotich ma otel.
somali: Kenya ayaa xaqiijisay 12 kiis oo kale oo COVID-19 ah, taasoo wadarta tirada ay gaartay 246. CS Caafimaadka Mutahi Kagwe ayaa sheegay in 5 ka mid ah ay yihiin shaqaale hoteel ah.

english: Religious leaders under World Council of Churches urge governments and donor countries to increase Global Fund support, to aid sustainable responses to HIV, tuberculosis, and malaria.
ekegusii: Abarai be chidini nse' ya oborai bwe chikanisa ase ense engima,bakoboria chiserekari na Chinse chia okorwa obokonyi,komenta obokonyi Bwa ekegancha Kia ense erinde gondereria emeroberio ya oborwaria Bwa enyamoreo,Esese na Esosera.

dholuo: Jotend din manie bwo riwruok mar World Council of Churches jiwo sirkande koda pinje machiwo kony mondo omed kony ma riwruok mar Global Fund chiwo, mondo okony e kedo gi AYAKI, kahera, kod malaria.

ekegusii: Chineti chie'chiumbu 10.9m chibekire eriogo ,kobagwa ase chikaunti 22 ase esegi ya okorwania Esosera.

english: Kenya confirms three new Mpox cases in Busia; Health Ministry warns of a high risk of importing Marburg and Ebola viruses from neighboring Tanzania and Sudan.
ekegusii: Kenya yaenekirie abanto batato gotwara oborwaire bwa MPOX ase ekaunti ya Busia. Ewizara ya Afya yakureire okonyarekana gw'okwambokeria ebirusi bya Marburg na Ebola korwa Chinse jirani chia Tanzania na Sudan.

dholuo: Kenya nyiso ni nitie ji adek manyien ma nigi tuwo mar Mpox e Busia; Migawo mar Thieth chiwo siem ni nitie masira maduong' mar kelo tuo mar Marburg kod Ebola koa Tanzania kod Sudan.
somali: Kenya ayaa xaqiijisay saddex kiis oo cusub oo Mpox ah oo ka dhacay Busia; Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ka digtay khatarta sare ee soo dejinta fayrasyada Marburg iyo Ebola ee ka imanaya Tanzania iyo Suudaan ee deriska ah.

english: Schools can be safe havens for mental health education
ekegusii: Chisukuru Nabo chikonyara koba chieng'encho mono ase obosemia bw'oborwaria bw'obongo/ebirengererio.
kiswahili: Shule zinaweza kuwa mahali salama pa elimu ya afya ya akili
dholuo: Skunde nyalo bedo kar buok mar tiego nyithindo e weche mag tuoche mag paro
somali: Dugsiyada waxay noqon karaan meel ammaan ah oo lagu barto caafimaadka dhimirka

english: Did you know? Your sleep quality directly affects your mental health! 1.Aim for 7-9 hours of restful sleep each night. 2. Avoid stimulants like caffeine or drugs before bed— they disrupt your Zzz's! Prioritize your rest, recharge your mind, and wake up refreshed!
ekegusii: Nomanyete? Enchera okorara chitoro nigo chigokuna oborwaria bwebirengererio biago. 1.Renga korara ase chinsa7-9 kera obotuko. 2.Etange na amariogo amo na ebinyugwa buna ekahawa nyuma otarara, ebikogosareria chitoro Beka motwe ogotimoka kwago, chaji obongo bwango ,erio oboke gosasogete!
kiswahili: Ulijua? Ubora wa usingizi wako huathiri moja kwa moja afya yako ya akili! 1. Lenga kulala kwa saa 7-9 kila usiku. 2. Epuka vichocheo kama vile kafeini au dawa za kulevya kabla ya kulala - vinavyovuruga hisia zako za Zzz! Zipe kipaumbele pumziko lako, chaji akili yako, na uamke ukiwa umeburudika!
somali: Ma ogtahay? Tayada hurdadaadu waxay si toos ah u saameyneysaa caafimaadka maskaxdaada! 1. Isku day inaad hurdo 7-9 saacadood oo nasasho ah habeen kasta. 2. Ka fogow waxyaabaha kiciya sida kafeyn ama daroogada ka hor intaadan seexan - waxay burburinayaan Zzz-kaaga!

english: Just like your annual doctor's visit, your mind deserves a check-up too
ekegusii: Buna ekero okogenda nyagitari kera omwaka korora omonyagitari, obongo bwao nabwo mboganeti korengwa.

english: Economic abuse limits financial independence. Financial institutions should recognize warning signs and support affected customers.

somali: Xiriirada aan xasilloonayn waxay taageerayaan amniga, sharafta, iyo xorriyadda dhammaan go'aamada ku saabsan macluumaadka iyo isticmaalka adeegyada.

ekegusii: Chisukuru goika chiikerania amachiko oborendi, gokorera abana abande bobe, na korwa obosemia erio korenda abana buya.
kiswahili: Shule lazima zitekeleze sera za ulinzi, mifumo ya kupambana na uonevu, na huduma za ushauri nasaha ili kuwalinda wanafunzi.
dholuo: Skunde onego oket chenro mag rito nyithindo, chenro mag kedo gi ichwanyruok, koda chiwo puonj mondo oritgo nyithindgi.
somali: Dugsiyada waa inay adeegsadaan siyaasadaha difaaca, nidaamyada ka hortagga burburka, iyo adeegyada la-talinta ardayda.

english: Child labor is illegal. Report hazardous child work to the Labour Department or call 0800220444.
ekegusii: Obosomba bwabana mamincha yerichiko. Karwe eripoti igoro yabana bare ase emeremo eranyare kobaretera emechando gochia chiofisi chitenererete obokori emeremo gose goaka esimi 0800220444.
kiswahili: Ajira kwa watoto ni kinyume cha sheria. Ripoti kazi hatarishi kwa watoto kwa Idara ya Kazi au piga simu 0800220444.
dholuo: Miyo nyithindo tije matek manyalo geng'o dongruokgi en wach ma chik odagi. Chiw ripot e namba 0800220444
somali: Warbixin ku saabsan shaqada khatarta ah ee carruurta ee Wasaaradda Shaqaalaha ama wac 082204444.

english: Children involved in legal processes should receive specialized legal aid through the Office of the Director of Public Prosecutions.
ekegusii: Abana abwo bare ase okoariganigwa gotamigwa mamincha yerichiko neganeirie konyora obokonyi mwachiko bosa goetera ofisi yomoteneneri bwobosoi ebina (ODPP).
kiswahili: Watoto wanaohusika katika michakato ya kisheria wanapaswa kupokea msaada maalum wa kisheria kupitia Ofisi ya Mkurugenzi wa Mashtaka ya Umma.
dholuo: Nyithindo ma wechegi iloso gi jood bura mag nyithindo onego oyud kony ma ichiwo kokalo kuom ofis mar Jatend Josed bura.
somali: Carruurta ku lug leh nidaamyada sharciga waa inay helaan caawimaad sharci oo gaar ah Xafiiska Xeer Ilaaliyaha Dadweynaha.

english: Every child has rights to education, healthcare, and protection. Communities must report violations.
ekegusii: Kera omwana nare noboronge bwokonyora chisemi, obobwenia, na oborendi. Abanto goika barwe eripoti igoro yotaikeranigwa kwayio.
kiswahili: Kila mtoto ana haki ya kupata elimu, huduma ya afya, na ulinzi. Jamii lazima ziripoti ukiukwaji.
dholuo: Nyathi ka nyathi nigi ratiro mar yudo somo, thieth, kod rit.
somali: Cunug kastaa wuxuu xaq u leeyahay waxbarasho, daryeel caafimaad, iyo ilaalinta. Bulshadu waa inay soo sheegaan xadgudubyada sharciga.

english: Children with disabilities face higher risks of abuse. Ensure inclusive education and accessible reporting mechanisms for their protection.
ekegusii: Abana bare noborema nigo ere raisi ase bare gokorerwa bobe. Rora nga abana bonsi ba kera engencho banyorire chisemi na buna baranyare komanyia igoro yogokorerwa bobe ase oborendi bwabo.
kiswahili: Watoto wenye ulemavu wanakabiliwa na hatari kubwa zaidi za unyanyasaji. Hakikisha elimu jumuishi na mifumo ya kuripoti inayopatikana kwa urahisi kwa ajili ya ulinzi wao.
dholuo: Nyithindo ma nigi midekre yudo pek mang'eny e kwedo timbe njore.
somali: Carruurta naafada ah ayaa khatarta ugu weyn ee lagu xadgudbo.

english: Refugee children are vulnerable to abuse and trafficking. Humanitarian agencies provide safe shelters and education in camps.
ekegusii: Abana ba baria batamete chisegi korwa sobo igo ere raisi ase bare gokorerwa bobe gokenganigwa gose koibwa. Ebiombe bikorwanerera oboronge bwekemwanyabanto bieserikari nkorwa bire obomenyo obuya nechisemi aaria ase chikambi.
kiswahili: Watoto wakimbizi wako katika hatari ya kudhulumiwa na kuuzwa nje ya nchi. Mashirika ya kibinadamu hutoa makazi salama na elimu katika kambi.
dholuo: Oganda ma konyo joma oringo thuchegi nyalo yudo kuonde dak kod tiegruok e kambi.
somali: Ururada xuquuqda aadanaha waxay xeryaha ku siiyaan hoy ammaan ah iyo waxbarasho.

english: Children's identities can be stolen for fraud. Parents should safeguard birth certificates and monitor credit reports.
ekegusii: nabo ekonyarekana nga ebiband biabana bibwe gokorera obongainereria. Abaibori brende buya chisatificate chiokoiborwa chia abana babo no komongera buna chibesa chigosao chisimi chiabo.
kiswahili: Utambulisho wa watoto unaweza kuibiwa kwa udanganyifu. Wazazi wanapaswa kulinda vyeti vya kuzaliwa na kufuatilia ripoti za mikopo.
dholuo: Jonyuol onego otang' gi omahundu manyalotiyo gi satifiket nyithindgi mag nyuol e kwalo pesa
somali: Carruurta waxaa laga qaadi karaa aqoonsiyada si ay u been abuuraan, waalidkuna waa inay ilaaliyaan shahaadooyinka dhalashada iyo warbixinnada amaahda.

english: Victims of sexual abuse need medical, legal, and psychological support. Specialized centers offer free services nationwide.
ekegusii: Baria bakoreirwe bobe gose gotibongwa nere buya konyora obokonyi bwobobwenia, kemachiko, anakebirengererio. Chisenta chiegeirie gokora emeremo eyio nkorwa chire obokonyi bwa bosa Kenya engima.
kiswahili: Waathiriwa wa unyanyasaji wa kijinsia wanahitaji usaidizi wa kimatibabu, kisheria, na kisaikolojia. Vituo maalum hutoa huduma za bure kote nchini.
dholuo: Joma isando e yor nindruok dwaro kony mar thieth, chike, kod weche mag thieth.
somali: Kuwa lagu xadgudbo galmada waxay u baahan yihiin caawimaad caafimaad, sharci iyo maskaxeed.

english: Many children drown in open water sources. Parents should supervise kids near pools, rivers, and wells.
ekegusii: Abana abange nigo bkogwa nagokwera ime yechinsemo chiamache. Abaibiri goika barande abana babio ekero bare ange nase aria agoakerwa ontimbu, chindoche, amo nechinsoko.
kiswahili: Watoto wengi huzama kwenye vyanzo vya maji vilivyo wazi. Wazazi wanapaswa kuwasimamia watoto karibu na madimbwi ya maji, mito, na visima.
dholuo: Nyithindo mang'eny thoga e pi ma yudore e dho nam, kendo jonyuol onego orit nyithindgi machiegni gi yawo, aore, kod sokni.
somali: Waalidiintu waxay u baahan yihiin inay carruurtooda ku ilaaliyaan meelaha ay ku yaalliin biyaha, webiyada iyo ceelasha.

english: Ensure school vans are properly licensed and drivers vetted to prevent accidents and kidnappings.
ekegusii: Rora nga chirori chisukuru nchuibwate chirensesi buya nomotereba buya achoretwe korenga gotanga emebasekano na koibwa kwa abana.
kiswahili: Hakikisha magari ya shule yana leseni ipasavyo na madereva wamechunguzwa ili kuzuia ajali na utekaji nyara.
dholuo: ng'iuru ni mtokni mag skul nigi ratiro mar ringo kendo ni derebe nigi ratiro mar tiegruok mondo kik gitim aksident
somali: Gawaarida dugsiyadu waxay leeyihiin ruqsado wanaagsan, darawaladiina waxay ka hortagaan shilalka iyo afduubka.

english: Teach children fire safety measures and ensure homes have working smoke detectors to prevent tragedies.
ekegusii: Somia abana chinhera chiokwerenda nomorero na rora ng'a chinka chibwate egento keria gekomanya ekero erioki rireo erio gokonya gotanga emerero gwateka.
kiswahili: Wafundishe watoto hatua za usalama wa moto na hakikisha nyumba zina vifaa vya kugundua moshi vinavyofanya kazi ili kuzuia majanga.
dholuo: Puonj nyithindo kaka ginyalo rito mach mondo gigeng' masiche.
somali: Carruurta ku bar tallaabooyinka ammaanka iyo hubinta in guryaha ay leeyihiin qalab lagu ogaado qiiqa si looga hortago musiibooyinka.

english: Families should include children in disaster drills and ensure they know emergency contacts.
ekegusii: Chifamiri goika chisangie abana babo amo koroberia buna baranyare gotange omorero tibwateka sobo na ekero bwatekire ase bagotamera gochia nechinamba chiesimi barangerie konyora ogokonya.
kiswahili: Familia zinapaswa kuwajumuisha watoto katika mazoezi ya majanga na kuhakikisha wanawajua watu wa dharura.
dholuo: Joot onego oriw nyithindo e tiegruok mag masiche kendo nyaka ging'e joma ginyalo tudorego gi joma nigi chandruok.
somali: Qoysaska waa inay carruurtooda ku darsadaan tababarka musiibada iyo inay hubiyaan inay yaqaanaan xaaladaha degdegga ah.

english: The Kenya Livestock Identification and Traceability System assigns herd numbers and ear tags to support theft prevention and disease control.
ekegusii: Omoreoberio o'Kenya komanya etugo, na komanya ase yarwete ngosambereria ore chiombe chinamba gose gochikera chinamba ase amato buna enchera yogotanga oboibi.
kiswahili: Mfumo wa Utambuzi na Ufuatiliaji wa Mifugo wa Kenya hugawa idadi ya mifugo na vitambulisho vya masikio ili kusaidia kuzuia wizi na kudhibiti magonjwa.
dholuo: Migao mar Kenya Animal Identification and Traceability System keto kwan mag jamni e itgi mondo okony e geng'o kuo kod geng'o tuoche.
somali: Hay'adda Kenya Livestock Identification and Tacecy System waxay bixisaa lambarrada kooxaha iyo aqoonsiyada dhegaha si ay u taageeraan ka hortagga tuugada iyo xakamaynta cudurrada.

english: Pastoralist migrations need planning. Obtain permits, choose safe routes, and avoid conflict areas.
ekegusii: Okonganya korwa aa gochia aaria kwa abatugi nkoganetie emeroberio emiya. Nyora ogwancherwa gwokong'anya netugo yao, etera ase atari nemechando, kabe are korwa chingongo chiria chire neminano.
kiswahili: Uhamiaji wa wafugaji unahitaji mipango. Pata vibali, chagua njia salama, na epuka maeneo yenye migogoro.
dholuo: dar gi jamni dwaro chenro, nyaka jorit chiaye yud rusa kendo yier yore maonge lweny
somali: Si aad u hesho rukhsad, u doorato waddo ammaan ah, oo aad uga fogaato meelaha khilaafaadka ka jira, dadka waxay u baahan yihiin inay sameeyaan qorshe socdaal ah.

english: Misuse of veterinary drugs creates resistance. Buy from licensed sources and follow prescriptions.
ekegusii: Koa etugo amriogo otabirie nabanyagitari betugo nigo egosaria obonyamasi bwetugo gose amariogo atari gokora egasi buya ase etugo. Gora amariogo korwa amonyagitari omoronge eriogo ribwate amalezo buya.
kiswahili: Matumizi mabaya ya dawa za mifugo husababisha upinzani. Nunua kutoka kwa vyanzo vilivyoidhinishwa na ufuate maagizo ya daktari.
dholuo: Tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero chando ji miyo ng'ato bedo gi chuny mar kwedo yedhe mamero.
somali: Isticmaalka xadgudubka ah ee daawooyinka xayawaanka waxay keentaa diidmo. waxay ka iibsadaan ilo ruqsad leh waxayna raacaan tilmaamaha dhakhtarka.

english: Industrial pollutants harm animals. Report dumping, fence off contaminated sites, and test water.
ekegusii: Obochafu bokorwa ase chifakitori nigo bokorentera etugo obokongu. Karwe eripoti igoro gotuguta obochafu bwabo ase enchera etari engiya, gita aase eubochafu bogotugutwa, na pima amche komanya gose nabwate ebinyinyi.
kiswahili: Uchafuzi wa viwandani huwadhuru wanyama. Ripoti utupaji taka, uzio mbali na maeneo yaliyochafuliwa, na jaribu maji.
dholuo: Gik ma chido ngima mag dhano nyalo hinyo le.
somali: Wasakheynta warshadaha ayaa waxyeelada u geysata xayawaanka.

english: Large birds prey on young livestock. Use scare devices and provide sheltered pens.
ekegusii: Ebibaki na makotu nigo akira ebichichu buna endagera yabo. Gitera etugoyao buya na rosia ebinto binga buna omonto obogoretie enyimbo gochia igoro na koyeka aroro kogosa ebinto ebio bitgete koira etugo.
kiswahili: Ndege wakubwa huwinda mifugo midogo. Tumia vifaa vya kutisha na uweke zizi zilizofunikwa.
dholuo: Winy madongo ohero chamo jamni matindo, ti kod gige buogo winy
somali: Shimbiraha waaweyn waxay ugaadhsadaan xoolaha yaryar waxayna adeegsadaan qalab ay ku cabsi galiyaan shimbiraha oo ay u sameeyaan daaqado qarsoodi ah.

english: Lightning kills grazing animals. Install lightning rods and avoid tying animals to isolated trees.
ekegusii: Enkoba nigo egoita etugo ere getii korisia. Beka ebinto biria bikobwata enkoba na tiga gosiba etugo ase omote ore oymo.
kiswahili: Umeme huua wanyama wanaochunga. Weka fimbo za umeme na epuka kuwafunga wanyama kwenye miti iliyotengwa.
dholuo: Mil polo nego chiaye, omiyo kik itwegi but yiende mabor.
somali: Hillaacyada ayaa dilaya xayawaanada quudinta leh; qalabka korontada ku dheji oo ka fogaada xayawaanada u duulaya geedaha fog.

english: Early warning prevents losses. Monitor conditions and share forecasts with herders.
ekegusii: Komanya omochando bwango nigo kogotanga asara. Rigeria buya komanya rire buna rire na sanga nabatugi bamino.
kiswahili: Onyo la mapema huzuia hasara. Fuatilia hali na ushiriki utabiri na wafugaji.
dholuo: nyis jokwath ranyisi mag yamo biro timore, mondo gikony chiaye
somali: Digniinta hore waxay ka hortagtaa khasaaraha.

english: The Judiciary warns of false bail refund letters sent to unsuspecting litigants. Refunds are processed only through court registries
ekegusii: Ekoti yaonyire abanto igoro yamarube oborimo ogotomwa gochia ekoti korigia koiranerigwa chibesa babegete ebondi false bail refund letters sent to unsuspecting litigants. Okoiranerigwa chibesa chiepondi nkotini kogokorerwa na tari ande onsi.
kiswahili: Mahakama yaonya kuhusu barua za kurejeshewa dhamana za uongo zinazotumwa kwa walalamikaji wasio na uhakika. Marejesho yanashughulikiwa kupitia sajili za mahakama pekee
dholuo: Bura chiwo siem kuom barupe mag miriambo mag dwoko pesa kuom gowi ma oor ne joma kia kaka kot tiyo
somali: Wargeyska Judiciary wuxuu ka digayaa warqadaha been abuurka ah ee loo diray dadka aan aqoon u lahayn.

english: EACC has flagged a syndicate offering forged title searches and valuations in Kisumu. Use verified government channels only
ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorwania obokengeka (EACC) yarure ogokurerwa igoro yamarube oborimo koa abanto emeremo, gose chinamba chiamaremo chioborimo, na korenga oboremo obwo nga nirenga boisaine aaria Kisumu. Tumia chiofisi chieserikari ekero otagete komanya ayio boronge.
kiswahili: EACC imeripoti kuwa shirika linalotoa utafutaji na uthamini bandia wa hati miliki huko Kisumu. Tumia njia za serikali zilizothibitishwa pekee
dholuo: EACC osechako mako jomiriambo mariambo ni gichiwo nonro mag title deed e piny Kisumu.
somali: EACC waxay kor u qaadday calanka daabacaadda ururka raadinta iyo qiimeynta cinwaanada luqadda Somali. Isticmaal kaliya idaacadaha dawladda ee la xaqiijiyay

english: "DCI confirms arrests of fake NGO representatives claiming to partner with World Food Programme in Northern Kenya. Always verify through official NGO registry."
ekegusii: "Omotuki omonene enekirie okobwatwa kwa abatenereri be'NGO boborimo bakweroka abakobwaterana nekeombe kia Omoroberio Bwendagera Bwense (World Food Programme) aaria Kenya ya Irianyi. Botambe manya boronge korwa egetabu gia NGO."
kiswahili: "DCI inathibitisha kukamatwa kwa wawakilishi bandia wa mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali wanaodai kushirikiana na Mpango wa Chakula Duniani Kaskazini mwa Kenya. Daima thibitisha kupitia usajili rasmi wa mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali."
dholuo: "DCI ne omak jomariambo ni tiyo gi riwruoge kaka World Food Programme e piny Kenya.
somali: "DCI waxay xaqiijineysaa in la qabtay wakiilo been abuur ah oo ka tirsan hay'adaha aan dowliga ahayn oo sheegta inay ka qaybqaataan Qorshaha Cuntada Adduunka ee Waqooyiga Kenya. Waxay had iyo jeer xaqiijineysaa diiwaangelinta rasmiga ah ee hay'adaha aan dowliga ahayn".

english: KRA reminds taxpayers that agents are not allowed to collect cash payments in person. Use official PayBill numbers and receipts
ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene giokorusia ebango gia Kenya (KRA) nkoinyoria kere baakani abango nga abaachenti babo tibaganeirie korusia ebango gose koegwa chibesa tbarabwo abanyene. Tumia enamba yabeene ya PayBill na nyora risiti riogoakana.
kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha walipa kodi kwamba mawakala hawaruhusiwi kukusanya malipo ya pesa taslimu ana kwa ana. Tumia nambari rasmi za PayBill na risiti
dholuo: KRA parone josol osuru ni ok oyienegi jotelo kawo pesa e wang' ji.
somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa canshuur bixiyeyaasha in wakiilada aan loo oggolaan in ay ururiyaan lacagtooda shakhsi ahaaneed.

english: EACC is investigating individuals posing as ministry auditors soliciting bribes from small schools. All inspections are officially scheduled and documented
ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwani obopkorekanu (EACC) ngotuka kere abanto gete bagwekora baria bakorigereria amatumisi yechibesa chieserikari na igo gosaba amaaki korwa ase chisukuru chinke. Okorigererigwa bwebitabu nigo gokoba ekero gwatangasirwe.
kiswahili: EACC inachunguza watu wanaojifanya wakaguzi wa wizara wanaoomba rushwa kutoka shule ndogo. Ukaguzi wote umepangwa rasmi na kuandikwa.
dholuo: EACC nono joma nyiso ni gin jorit-tinda mag sirkal kendo manyo asoya e skunde matindo.
somali: EACC waxay baaritaan ku sameyneysaa dadka isku dayga ah ee iskuulada yaryar ka codsanaya musuqmaasuqa.

english: The Ministry of Transport has received reports of fake NTSA agents collecting bribes along major highways. Report any suspicious activity via 999 or NTSA portal
ekegusii: Emonistiri yobobogoria yanyorire amang'ana igoro yabateneneri boborimo ba (NTSA) bagosaba amaaki ase chinhera chinene. Karwe amangana igoro yamang'ana anga buna ayio are nechitang'utang'u naro goetera enamba yesimi yamorero 999 gose eintaneti ya (NTSA)
kiswahili: Wizara ya Uchukuzi imepokea ripoti za maajenti bandia wa NTSA wakikusanya rushwa kwenye barabara kuu. Ripoti shughuli yoyote ya kutiliwa shaka kupitia 999 au lango la NTSA
dholuo: Tij Lando osemiyo ofis mar weche mag wuoth ofwenyo ni joma ok kare ma tiyo gi NTSA ne kawo asoya e nderni madongo.
somali: Wasaaradda Gaadiidka waxay heshay warbixin ku saabsan wakiilada been abuurka ah ee NTSA oo musuqmaasuq ka qaadaya waddooyinka waaweyn.

english: KRA warns taxpayers not to use agents who claim they can erase penalties for a fee. All tax waivers are issued through formal channels.
ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete korusia ebango (KRA) kiarure ogokurera ase baria bagoakana chikodi chiabo tibatumia abaachenti abwo bakobang'aina nga nabo baranyare gotinyia chifaini chiabo ase okorwa gento geke. Okonacherwa gose kogokeaneri abango nigo kogokorwa goetera enchera ya ofisi yoka.
kiswahili: KRA yaonya walipa kodi kutotumia mawakala wanaodai wanaweza kufuta adhabu kwa ada. Misamaha yote ya kodi hutolewa kupitia njia rasmi.
dholuo: KRA chiwo siem ne josol osuru ni kik giti gi joma wacho ni ginyalo rucho osuru bang' chudo.
somali: KRA waxay ka digeysaa cashuur bixiyayaasha inay u adeegsadaan qareenada sheeganaya inay joojin karaan ganaaxyada lacag bixinta.

english: "Public notice: DCI has shut down a fraudulent real estate company operating under multiple names in Kiambu. Always perform a search at the Lands Ministry."
ekegusii: "Ogokurera ase bonsi": Omotuki omonene osiekire ekampani yobokengeka ogokora obokengeka bwaye goetera amarieta ao ao aaria Kiambu ekongaina abanto kobaoneria emechi yokomenya operating. Kera engaki rigia komanya obomaene bwebinto binga buna ebio korwa ofosi yamaremo."
kiswahili: "Taarifa kwa umma: DCI imefunga kampuni ya ulaghai ya mali isiyohamishika inayofanya kazi kwa majina mengi huko Kiambu. Daima fanya utafutaji katika Wizara ya Ardhi."
dholuo: DCI osemako jomatimo ohand lowo e yo morochore kiambu
somali: "Ogaysiiska dadweynaha: DCI waxay xidhtay shirkad beero iyo guri been abuur ah oo ku shaqeysa magacyo kala duwan Kiambu. Had iyo jeer waxay baaritaan ku sameysaa Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda".

english: "Be cautious of agents offering NHIF registration at matatu stages. Report such individuals to the nearest police post. NHIF registration is free."
ekegusii: "Kabe maiso korwa abanto bagwekora ng'a nkorika bare ase omoroberio bweinsuarensi ya nyagitari (NHIF) abwo ase chirori chikorinerwa. Ripoti abanto abwo ase eporisi ere ange naye. Kwerika koba oyomo ase Einsuarensi ya Nyagitari (NHIF) mbosa egokorwa."
kiswahili: "Kuwa mwangalifu na mawakala wanaotoa usajili wa NHIF katika hatua za matatu. Waripoti watu kama hao kwenye kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu. Usajili wa NHIF ni bure."
dholuo: "Bed motang' gi joma chiwo kwayo mar ng'ado nying' e NHIF e stadiums mag matatu.
somali: "Ka taxaddar saraakiisha booliska ee isdiiwaangaliya saldhigyada saddexaad.

english: Use a VPN on public networks to encrypt your internet traffic.
ekegusii: Tumia chinamba chiesiri ekero ogosoa ase Wi-Fi yabanto bonsi erio bwerende korwa abant barengete koyetuka komanya ninki kere ime.
kiswahili: Tumia VPN kwenye mitandao ya umma ili kuficha trafiki yako ya intaneti.
dholuo: Ti gi VPN e intanet mondo ipand weche mitime intanet.
somali: Isticmaal shabakadda VPN ee shabakadaha dadweynaha si aad u qariso adeegyadaada internetka.

english: Don't write your passwords down in a book! Use an app like 'SafePass' to save them.
ekegusii: Tiga korika ringana riao riesiri riesimi goge ebengi ase egetabu! Tumia omoroberio beintanati yao ekero okoyeigora 'SafePass' rio korenda ringana erio ria riabobisi.
kiswahili: Usiandike manenosiri yako kwenye kitabu! Tumia programu kama 'SafePass' kuyahifadhi.
dholuo: ti gi app kaka 'SafePass' mondo iket paswad e yo maber.
somali: Ha qorin erayadaada qarsoodiga ah kitaab.

english: Use biometrics (fingerprint/face ID) instead of PINs where possible.
ekegusii: Tumia egento buna ekiara kiao gose epicha yobosio bwao rika ria enamba yesiri ase ekonyarekana.
kiswahili: Tumia biometriki (alama za vidole/kitambulisho cha uso) badala ya PIN inapowezekana.
dholuo: Ti gi pichni mag dhano (fingerprint/face ID) kar tiyo gi PIN ka nyalore.
somali: Haddii ay suurtogal tahay, laba farac u isticmaal halkii aad ka heli lahayd PIN-yada.

english: Download apps only from Google Play Store or Apple App Store.
ekegusii: Nyora ebinto biria gigokonya esimi gokora emeremo yaye goetera Google Play Store gose Apple App Store.
kiswahili: Pakua programu kutoka Duka la Google Play au Duka la Programu la Apple pekee.
dholuo: Gol app mana e Google Play Store kata Apple App Store.
somali: Codsiyada ka soo dejiso Google Play Stost ama Apple Store oo keliya.

english: Ignore messages like 'Youve won Safaricom Jackpot!'Theyre scams.
ekegusii: Ombia amang'ana ameng'e esimi buna 'Kwabuire ejakipoti ya Safaricom' Aya namangana arengete gokoibera.
kiswahili: Puuza jumbe kama 'Umeshinda Safaricom Jackpot!'Ni ulaghai.
dholuo: Kik iwinj weche kaka, 'Iseloso Safaricom Jackpot!'
somali: Diidmada fariimaha sida "Waxaad ku guuleysatay Safaricom Jackpot!"

english: Back up important data to an external drive to avoid ransomware attacks.
ekegusii: Rosia ekopi yamangana ao yengencho ase esimi goe ekombiuta gochia ekegachi kende terio gwekonya korwa ogosarigwa nebinyinyi
kiswahili: Hifadhi nakala rudufu ya data muhimu kwenye kiendeshi cha nje ili kuepuka mashambulizi ya ransomware.
dholuo: Golo weche madongo e kompyuta mondo kik gimi program mar ransomware omonjgi.
somali: Soo celinta macluumaadka muhiimka ah si looga fogaado weerarada madaxfurashada.

english: Don't use 'Mothers maiden name' for security questions! Use a fictional answer.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gotumia erieta riorera ria mama omino buna ring'ana ria riobobisi bwesimi gose ekombiuta. Tumia erieta riokwebaka orayare koinyora.
kiswahili: Usitumie 'Jina la ukoo la Mama' kwa maswali ya usalama! Tumia jibu la kubuni.
dholuo: Kik iti gi nying mamau sama iseto paswad, to ti gi dwoko ma ok nyal bedo adier.
somali: Ha isticmaalin magaca 'Hooyada' su'aalaha amniga!

english: If you are looking for customer support, use the numbers on the company's website.
ekegusii: Onye gokorigia ogokonywa korwa ekambani, tumia chinamba chiesimi gose eintaneti yekambani.
kiswahili: Ikiwa unatafuta huduma kwa wateja, tumia nambari zilizo kwenye tovuti ya kampuni.
dholuo: Kapo ni idwaro kony ne joodi, ti gi namba manie websait mar kambi.
somali: Haddii aad raadineyso taageero macaamiisha, isticmaal lambarrada ku jira websaydhka shirkadda.

english: Visit rental properties in person. Online listings can be fake.
ekegusii: Tarera chinyomba chigokomboa aye omonyene. Amangana goetera eintaneti nabo arabe oborimo.
kiswahili: Tembelea nyumba za kukodisha ana kwa ana. Orodha za mtandaoni zinaweza kuwa bandia.
dholuo: Dhi e ute mipango iwuon kapok ichulo
somali: Soo booqashada hantida canshuurta ee shakhsi ahaaneed. Liisaska internetka waxay noqon karaan kuwo been abuur ah.

english: Use ad blockers to stop malicious pop-ups like 'Youve won an iPhone!'.
ekegusii: Tumia egento kegotanga amangana ogotangasa ebiasara buan kwanyorire esimi iPhone eye nencher eyemo yogotanga ebinyibigosaria esimi giose ekombiuta yao.
kiswahili: Tumia vizuizi vya matangazo ili kuzuia madirisha ibukizi hasidi kama vile 'Umeshinda iPhone!'.
dholuo: Ti gi gige geng'o weche miriambo kaka 'Isebedo gi iPhone!'
somali: Isticmaal ka hortagga codka si aad u joojiso dhawaaqa waxyeelada leh sida " iPhone-ka waad ka adkaatay!

english: "Do not download apps from random websites. Always use Google Play Store or Apple App Store. Unverified apps may contain malware."
ekegusii: "Tiga korusia ebikoreri biria bigonya esimi gokora egasi korwa eintaneti aende yonsi. Kera engaki binyore korwa Google Play Store gose Apple App Store".
kiswahili: "Usipakue programu kutoka kwa tovuti zisizo rasmi. Tumia Duka la Google Play au Duka la Programu la Apple kila wakati. Programu ambazo hazijathibitishwa zinaweza kuwa na programu hasidi."
dholuo: "Kik igo app moko e websait moogoreopogore. Ti gi Google Play Store kata Apple App Store kinde duto.
somali: "Ha ku rakibin barnaamijyo goobaha aan barnaamij lahayn... had iyo jeer isticmaal Google Plave Host ama Apple Appp dukaanka.

english: Do not share your MPESA PIN with anyone. Safaricom and banks will never ask for it. If in doubt, call official support.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gosanga enemba yao yobobisi ya MPESA nonde bwensi. Safaricom gose ebengi mbarikobori koboria nga obayetebie. Ekero ore nechitangutangu yeringana erio, rangeria ebengi yao koboria buya okonywe.
kiswahili: Usishiriki PIN yako ya MPESA na mtu yeyote. Safaricom na benki hazitaiomba kamwe. Ikiwa una shaka, piga simu kwa usaidizi rasmi.
dholuo: Kik ipog PIN mar MPESA gi ng'ato ang'ata. Safaricom kod bengi ok bi kwayo ng'atno.
somali: Ha u qorin PIN-kaaga qofna. Safaricom iyo bangiyada marnaba ma weydiisan doonaan.

english: Secure heavy furniture to walls to prevent tip-over accidents with children.
ekegusii: Torerania ebinto buna eborogo gose chimesa chidito nyomba ase chinyasi gokonya hitichigwera abana ekero bagotema korina igoro.
kiswahili: Funga samani nzito kwenye kuta ili kuzuia ajali za watoto zinazotokea wakati wa kuanguka.
dholuo: Ket gige ot ma pek ahinya e kor ohinga mondo kik nyithindo ochwanyre.
somali: Darbiyada ku dheji qalab culus oo ammaan ah si looga hortago shilal aan macquul aheyn oo carruurta ku dhaca.

english: Learn basic swimming skills - it could save your life or someone else's.
ekegusii: Egegera buna oranyare goaka ontimbu -nabo eragokonye gose gokonya omonto onde.
kiswahili: Jifunze ujuzi wa msingi wa kuogelea - inaweza kuokoa maisha yako au ya mtu mwingine.
dholuo: Puonjri ng'eyo kaka inyalo goyo abal- inyalo reso ngimani kata ngima ng'at machielo.
somali: Baro xirfadaha aasaasiga ah ee dabaasha - waxay badbaadin karaan naftaada ama qof kale.

english: Put emergency contacts in your phone: Police (999), Ambulance (911), Fire (990).
ekegusii: Bechaka chinamba chiemebasekano ime ase esimi yao: Porisi (999), Egari yemebasekano (911), Omorero bwatekire (990).
kiswahili: Weka anwani za dharura kwenye simu yako: Polisi (999), Ambulensi (911), Zimamoto (990).
dholuo: Ket nembni ma nyalo konyo e simo: Polis (999), Ambulance (911), Fire (990).
somali: Ka hortag xiriirada xaaladaha degdegga ah ee telefoonkaaga: Booliska (999), Ambulance (911), Dab-damiska (990).

english: Create a family emergency plan and meeting point for disasters.
ekegusii: Manyererania genkio nabanto benyoma yao aase ogotamera chingaki chiomobasekano.
kiswahili: Unda mpango wa dharura wa familia na mahali pa kukutania majanga.
dholuo: Tim chenro mar rito joodi e kinde masira.
somali: Qorshaha xaaladaha degdegga ah ee qoyska iyo meelaha shirarka loogu talagalay musiibooyinka.

english: Keep mosquito repellent at home, especially during the rainy season.
ekegusii: Kabe naguta aria agoseria chiimbu korwa nyomba, na mono kegima chingaki chiembura.
kiswahili: Weka dawa ya kufukuza mbu nyumbani, hasa wakati wa mvua.
dholuo: Bed gi yath ma geng'o kute e odi, to ahinya ahinya e kinde koth.
somali: Guriga ku hay daawooyin lagu tuuro dufanka, gaar ahaan xilliga roobka.

english: Keep your doctor's and hospital's numbers nearby in case of emergencies.
ekegusii: Gacha enmba yanyagitari nomonyagitari oo ange nase ebogete omobuko oo bwemebasekano buna amarigo.
kiswahili: Weka nambari za daktari wako na hospitali karibu iwapo kutatokea dharura.
dholuo: Ket namba mar laktar kod mar osiptal machiegni kodi kapo ni nitie gimoro ma chando chunyi.
somali: Haddii xaalad degdeg ah dhacdo, xisaabaadka dhakhtarkaaga ku hay isbitaalka.

english: If you have farms, clearly label fertilizers and pesticides.
ekegusii: Onye kobwate omogondo bwoboremi, orokereria buya obwoyo mborobi, n amariogo boigo.
kiswahili: Kama una mashamba, weka lebo wazi kwenye mbolea na dawa za kuua wadudu.
dholuo: Kapo ni in gi puothe, ket tong' maler e wi yien kod yedhe mamero.
somali: Haddii aad leedahay beero, si cad u sheeg bacriminta iyo cayayaanka.

english: Install peepholes in exterior doors to identify visitors before opening.
ekegusii: Bochora ebingoro biabeene ase emerangu yaisiko kogokonya korora nakomanya omonto korwa nyomba otaramogorera.
kiswahili: Weka vizuizi vya macho kwenye milango ya nje ili kuwatambua wageni kabla ya kufungua.
dholuo: Keturu kuonde ma ji nyalo ng'iyoe dhoot mondo ging'e ka pok giyawo.
somali: Albaabada dibedda ka dhig godad si aad u aqoonsato martida ka hor intaadan furin.

english: Keep car keys in a secure location at home, not near doors/windows.
ekegusii: Gacha ebibunguo bierori yao inka ase agiya, korende tari ase omorangu gose etirisa.
kiswahili: Weka funguo za gari mahali salama nyumbani, si karibu na milango/madirisha.
dholuo: Ket okombeni mag mtoka kama oting'o maber, to ok machiegni gi dhoot kata dirisa.
somali: Furayaasha baabuurta guriga ku hay meel aamin ah oo aan albaabada iyo albaabada u dhow.

english: Use different routes when traveling regularly to avoid establishing patterns.
ekegusii: Etera chinhera ao ao echi ogosokera korwa inka na koirana erio osirerio amabarato yorogendo rwao buna enchera eyemo yokwerenda.
kiswahili: Tumia njia tofauti unaposafiri mara kwa mara ili kuepuka kuweka mifumo.
dholuo: Sama iwuotho e yo mopogore opogore, kik idonj e wuoth ma kamano.
somali: Isticmaal siyaabo kala duwan markaad si joogto ah u safrayso si aad uga fogaato caqabadaha.

english: Promote integrity and transparency in all institutions. Together, we can prevent corruption before it starts.
ekegusii: Segeta ekeene nobomaiso marore ase chinsemo chionsi chiobokoreri. Ase oboamo, nabo togotanga obokorekanu tiboba.
kiswahili: Kukuza uadilifu na uwazi katika taasisi zote. Kwa pamoja, tunaweza kuzuia ufisadi kabla haujaanza.
dholuo: Jiwo winjruok maber gi riwruoge duto, kendo timo kamano biro miyo kik wadonj e mibadhi kapok ochakore.
somali: Waxaan ka hortagi karnaa musuqmaasuqa ka hor inta uusan bilaabin.

english: Use tracking devices for valuable items like electronics and vehicles.
ekegusii: Beka erori yao ebinto biria biranyare koyebwatia gose koyerora ase ere ekero yaibirwe nebinto binde bia bionsi biingencho.
kiswahili: Tumia vifaa vya kufuatilia vitu vya thamani kama vile vifaa vya elektroniki na magari.
dholuo: Ti gi gik ma nyalo miyo ng'ato oyud gik ma nengogi tek kaka gik mamoko ma korgi tek kaka gik mag elektronika kod mtokni.
somali: Isticmaal qalab qiimo leh sida qalabka elektaroonigga ah iyo baabuurta.

english: Be wary of strangers offering unsolicited help with ATMs or banking.
ekegusii: Eborie buya igoro tabanto otamanyeti bakorwa ogokonya kwa bosa goetera obokoreri bwechisimi, (ATMs) gose ebengi.
kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu na wageni wanaotoa msaada usioombwa na ATM au benki.
dholuo: Tang' gi joma ok ing'eyo ma nyalo konyi tiyo gi gige pesa kata gige bengi.
somali: Ka digtoonow dadka aadan aqoon ee ku siinaya caawimaad aan la weydiin ATM ama bangi.

english: Create inventory of household items with photos and receipts for insurance.
ekegusii: Rika inse ebinto bionsi bia mwao. biake chibicha na gacha amarisiti kwabigorerete gonya insuarensi kogoakana ekero birayie gose koibwa.
kiswahili: Tengeneza orodha ya vitu vya nyumbani ukitumia picha na risiti za bima.
dholuo: Tim nonro mar gik ma itiyogo e ot, kaachiel gi piche kod kweno mag insuarans.
somali: Liiska alaabta guriga oo leh sawirada iyo rasiidhada caymiska.

english: Keep shrubbery near entry points low to maintain visibility.
ekegusii: Simeka amaoga ase omorangwa gose egesona kiao.
kiswahili: Weka vichaka karibu na sehemu za kuingilia chini ili kudumisha mwonekano.
dholuo: Ket yiende ma ne ni machiegni gi kama ne idonjoe piny mondo kik gikethre.
somali: Dhirta hoos u dhig si aan loo arki karin.

english: Don't leave spare keys in obvious places like under doormats or flowerpots.
ekegusii: Totiba ekopi yebinguo biao bia kobera aase aamo engaki entambe buna inse yomogeka bwenyomba gose ase enyongo yamaoga - bichenchie kera engaki.
kiswahili: Usiache funguo za ziada katika sehemu zinazoonekana wazi kama vile chini ya mikeka ya mlango au vyungu vya maua.
dholuo: Kik iweya gi ofungu mamoko e kuonde ma nenore ayanga kaka e bwo dhoot kata e bwo piende mag maua.
somali: Furaha dheeriga ah ha ku dhigin meel bannaan, tusaale ahaan albaabka ama ubaxyada.

english: Use security bars or grilles on vulnerable windows and doors.
ekegusii: Sambereria egiriri ase chitirisa nemerangu gochikong'ia.
kiswahili: Tumia baa za usalama au grille kwenye madirisha na milango iliyo hatarini.
dholuo: Ti gi bar kata gir mag rito yien e dirise kod dhoot ma nyalo bedo ni ok nyal geng'o.
somali: Ka dhig daaqadaha iyo albaabada birta lagu ilaaliyo oo si fudud u burburin kara.

english: If you have information, #ReachDCI through hotline number 0800 722 203. Let's work together to uphold justice and accountability. #FichuaGaitho
ekegusii: Onye kore nering'ana, #Moikera omotuki omonene goetera enamba ya morero 0800 722 203. Tiga tokore emeremo amo gosegeta ekeene nobotenereri obuya. #Bisora Gaitho
kiswahili: Kama una taarifa, #Wasiliana naDCI kupitia nambari ya simu 0800 722 203. Tushirikiane kudumisha haki na uwajibikaji. #FichuaGaitho
dholuo: Ka in gi weche, tudri gi #ReachDCI e simo mar 0800 722 203. We wati kanyachiel mondo warit ratiro kod bura. #FichuaGaitho
somali: Haddii aad haysato macluumaad, #ReachDCI telefoonka 0800 722 203. Aan wada shaqeyno si aan u difaacno xuquuqda iyo mas'uuliyadda. #FichuaGaitho

english: Consider installing a safe for important documents and valuables.
ekegusii: Nere buya koba nase agiya okobeka amanag'ana ao na ebinto biaobiengencho.
kiswahili: Fikiria kufunga sefu ya kuhifadhia hati muhimu na vitu vya thamani.
dholuo: Tem keto sanduk ma nyalo konye kano weche madongo kod gik ma nengogi tek.
somali: Ka fikir inaad meel ammaan ah ku dhigto dukumiintiyada muhiimka ah iyo waxyaabaha qaaliga ah.

english: IMLU report on community policing committees in Narumoru (serving Nyeri and Nyandarua region)
ekegusii: Ekeombe kia IMLU kiarure eripoti igoro yechikomoti chiabarendi boborendi aaria Narumoru (egokorera ensemo ya Nyandarua)
kiswahili: Ripoti ya IMLU kuhusu kamati za polisi jamii huko Narumoru (zinazohudumia mkoa wa Nyeri na Nyandarua)
dholuo: Ripot mar IMLU e wi komiti mag polise e Narumoru (ma tiyo ne alwora mar Nyeri kod Nyandarua)
somali: Warbixinta IMLU ee ku saabsan guddiyada maamulka bulshada ee Narumoru (xannaanada xayawaanka iyo xayawaanka)

english: All 47 Kenyan county security committee members received training in community policing and prevention of violent extremism
ekegusii: Abarendi boborendi bechikaonti chionsi 47 mbanyorete amasomo amao nabateneneri boborendi bebinyoro abanyene gotanga obosareki bwogoonchorwa ebirengererio.
kiswahili: Wajumbe wote 47 wa kamati ya usalama ya kaunti ya Kenya walipata mafunzo katika ulinzi wa jamii na kuzuia itikadi kali za kikatili
dholuo: Jood komiti mar weche sirkal duto 47 ma Kenya noyudo tiegruok e weche mag rito oganda kendo geng'o timbe gero
somali: Dhammaan 47 xubnood oo ka tirsan guddiga ammaanka ee degmada Kenya ayaa la tababaray diiwaangelinta bulshada iyo ka hortagga diinta adag

english: TOday GBV-capacity workshop with NPS and community figures across Kisumu subcounties
ekegusii: Rero ogomomia gokinia okomanya igoro yogokorera bobe abande ase yeki bare ase abasikari nabanto bande bebinyoro basikire ase amechie emeke yonsi inse ye'kaonti ya Kisumu
kiswahili: Leo warsha ya uwezo wa GBV na NPS na watu mashuhuri katika jamii katika kaunti ndogo za Kisumu
dholuo: Tiegruok mar tiyo gi GBV mar odiechieng' kodiechieng' gi jotelo mag NPS kod jomamoko e alwora duto mar Kisumu
somali: aqoon isweydaarsiga TOday GBV-caclacity oo ay ku jiraan NPS iyo tirakoobka bulshada ee deegaanada Kisumu

english: Regional police launch COP-informed operations profiling gangs and increasing patrols in Kisumu County
ekegusii: Abarai babateneneri bwokoreri bwabasikari bechingo babekirwe goikerani obokoreri obuya ase okomanya abasaria ba kera engencho nagotoma abasikari gochia ase ayio aaria ekaonti ya Kisumu.
kiswahili: Polisi wa eneo hilo wazindua operesheni zinazoongozwa na COP za kuorodhesha magenge na kuongeza doria katika Kaunti ya Kisumu
dholuo: Polise mag alwora chako tijni mar manyo joma biro ketho riwruok mar oganda Jehova kendo medo rito kuonde ma ji dhiyoe e alwora mar Kisumu County
somali: Ciidamada Booliska Gobolka ayaa bilaabay dhaqdhaqaaqyo COP ah oo dhiirigelinaya kooxaha iyo kor u qaadista ilaalada Gobolka Kisumu

english: A review detailed IPOA's achievements, challenges, and strategic direction and outlined next steps in police accountability reform.
ekegusii: Okorigereria keboyia ngwatebe geikaranu buna ekeombe keria gietenererete kia abasikari (IPOA) giakorire buya, emechamndo ereo, amo nemeroberio yabeene yar koorokia ebitambokero bia motwe biogoikerania abasikari gotenera ebikotu biegasi yabo.
kiswahili: Mapitio yalielezea kwa kina mafanikio ya IPOA, changamoto, na mwelekeo wa kimkakati na kuainisha hatua zinazofuata katika mageuzi ya uwajibikaji wa polisi.
dholuo: Nonro moro ne olero e yo matut gik ma IPOA osetimo, pek ma oyudo, kod yo ma gichano mar lochoe, kendo ne olero okang' ma biro luwo e loso chike mag polis.
somali: Dib u eegis faahfaahsan oo ku saabsan guulaha, caqabadaha, iyo tilmaamaha sare iyo tilmaamaya tallaabooyinka soo socda ee xisaabinta booliska.

english: IPOA issued updates on detainee fatality investigations and outlined measures to improve custodial conditions.
ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gietenerete korigereria buna abasikariba gokora emeremo yabo (IPOA) nkiarwete eripoti yobotuki bwabo igoro yabaria babegetwe chiseri na buna baumiete amo nemeroberio yokorora ng'a baria bonsi babwatetwe mbaegwe obosibore bwabo ime yechiseri.
kiswahili: IPOA ilitoa taarifa mpya kuhusu uchunguzi wa vifo vya wafungwa na kuainisha hatua za kuboresha hali ya kifungo.
dholuo: IPOA ne ogolo weche manyien e wi nonro mar tho mar joma otwe kendo ne olero okang' ma ne onego oluw mondo okony joma otwe.
somali: IPOA waxay soo saartay warbixin cusub oo ku saabsan baaritaanka dilka booliiska waxayna tilmaamaysaa tallaabooyin lagu hagaajin karo xaaladaha koritaanka.

english: An IPOA warning stated that silence within the police force enables impunity and called for cultural reforms and safe reporting.
ekegusii: Ogokurerwa korwa ekeombe keria gietenerete korigereria buna abasikari bagokora emeremo yabo (IPOA)ngwatebete ng'a ogotakwana buna abasikari bagokora bobe nenchera eyemo yagerire abasikari bagendererete gokora amamocho na gotegwa egesusuro, nagosaba ng'a oboonchoreria goetera chinchera chiegenka kobe erio korwa ribaga abanto koripoti.
kiswahili: Onyo la IPOA lilisema kwamba ukimya ndani ya jeshi la polisi huwezesha kutokujali na lilitaka mageuzi ya kitamaduni na kuripoti kwa usalama.
dholuo: Siem moro mar IPOA nowacho ni ling'ling' ei polise miyo ji bedo maonge ketho kendo ne okwayo ni otim lokruok e kit ngima ji kendo mondo weche duto ma timore kik lal.
somali: Digniinta IPOA waxay sheegtay in aaminnimada ciidanka booliska ay ka caawineyso in laga fogaado ciqaabta iyo in la codsado isbeddelka dhaqanka iyo in lagu soo wargeliyo si ammaan ah.

english: Guidance provided on how to file police misconduct complaints and the rights of complainants.
ekegusii: Oborai borure buna obwenerete komanyia abatenereri babasikari buna bagokora bobe gose okwemuranganania amo noboronge bwoyokwemuranganania.
kiswahili: Mwongozo umetolewa kuhusu jinsi ya kuwasilisha malalamiko ya utovu wa nidhamu wa polisi na haki za walalamikaji.
dholuo: Puonj ochiw e wi kaka inyalo donj ne polise e weche mag ketho chik kod ratiro mag joma odonjnego.
somali: Tilmaamaha waxaa lagu bixiyay sida loo xalliyo cabashooyinka ku saabsan dhaqdhaqaaqa xun ee booliska iyo xuquuqda dacwad-bixiyayaasha.

english: NPS refuted a false terror alert online and urged verification through official channels.
ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kia abasikari (NPS) mbangete amangana oborimo igoro yokobamanyia obokebago goetera eintaneti, na bagasorora ng'a koenekia amangana ayio nere buya akoreke goetera chichera chiria chireo chiokobamanyia.
kiswahili: NPS ilikanusha tahadhari ya uwongo ya ugaidi mtandaoni na kuhimiza uthibitishaji kupitia njia rasmi.
dholuo: NPS ne okwedo siem ma miriambo mar luoro e intanet kendo ne okwayo mondo okonygi ng'eyo wachno kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal.
somali: NPS waxay diidday hanjabaadaha been abuurka ah ee internetka waxayna ku riixday xaqiijinta kanaalka rasmiga ah.

english: Public informed of an Al-Shabaab attack in Garissa and encouraged to stay vigilant as security heightened.
ekegusii: Abanainchi bamanyiigwe igoro yebikoreri bia akili bandia Al bia -Shabaab goaka epomu Garissa, na kobaa omoyo gotigara maiso ekiagera oborendi bwagesirwe.
kiswahili: Umma umearifiwa kuhusu shambulio la Al-Shabaab huko Garissa na kuhimizwa kuwa macho huku usalama ukiimarishwa.
dholuo: Ji duto ne olando ni Al-Shabaab ne omonjo Garissa kendo ne ojiwogi ni gisik ka girito ka sirkal medo bedo motegno.
somali: Wararka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan weerarkii Al-Shabaab ku qaadeen magaalada Garissa ayaa ku dhiirrigeliyay in la ilaaliyo nabadgelyada markii ay dab ka dhacday.

english: Security operations intensified in Kitale and North Rift to combat cattle rustling with specialized units deployed.
ekegusii: Emeroberio yoborendi aaria Kitale na North Rift bangangane gokora aboibi bwechiombe ase okobwaterana nebitengo bieserikari bia beene biatomirwe aroro.
kiswahili: Shughuli za usalama ziliimarishwa Kitale na North Rift ili kupambana na wizi wa mifugo huku vikosi maalum vikiwekwa.
dholuo: Ne omedo tiyo gi yore mag rito dhok e Kitale kod North Rift mondo giked gi ywaruok ma ne nitie e kind dhok.
somali: Waxqabadyada difaaca ayaa la kordhiyay Qalabka iyo Dooxada Waqooyiga Waqooyiga si looga hortago lo'da si degdeg ah u duulaya oo leh qaybo gaar ah.

english: US Embassy imposed travel restrictions for staff in six counties due to insecurity.
ekegusii: Obobalosi bwa America (US Embassy) aiga Kenya mbwarwete ogokurera gochia abanto babo koba maiso gotarera chikaonti 6 aiga Kenya ekiagera oborendi botaisaine aroro.
kiswahili: Ubalozi wa Marekani uliweka vikwazo vya usafiri kwa wafanyakazi katika kaunti sita kutokana na ukosefu wa usalama.
dholuo: Amerka ne ogolo chike mag wuoth ne jotich e gwenge auchiel nikech ne onge ritruok.
somali: Safaaradda Maraykanka ayaa xannibay safarka shaqaalaha lix gobol sababtoo ah ammaan la'aanta.

english: Additional personnel were deployed to Naivasha to secure the Safari Rally event.
ekegusii: Abakori emeremo abange batomirwe gochia Naivasha kobeka oborendi ekero gia Safari Rally event.
kiswahili: Wafanyakazi wengine walitumwa Naivasha ili kuhakikisha tukio la Safari Rally.
dholuo: Ne oor jotich mamoko e taondno mondo omi gitim chokruok mar Safari Rally.
somali: Shaqaalaha kale waxaa loo diray Naivasha si ay safarka u sameeyaan mid saaxiibtinimo leh.

english: NPS reminded officers to avoid misuse of force during protests and maintain professionalism.
ekegusii: Ekombe keria ekenene gia abasikari (NPS) kiainyoirie abobisa baye gotatumia chibunduki bobe chingaki chiokoroberekana na goikerania obokoreri emeremo obuya.
kiswahili: NPS iliwakumbusha maafisa kuepuka matumizi mabaya ya nguvu wakati wa maandamano na kudumisha weledi.
dholuo: NPS noparo ne jotend polis ni kik giti gi teko e yo marach e kinde mag mor kendo gitim gik ma nyiso ni gin joma olony.
somali: NPS waxay xasuusisay saraakiisha booliska inay ka fogaadaan isticmaalka xoogga xad-dhaafka ah intii lagu jiray mudaaharaadyada iyo inay ilaaliyaan awoodda aqooneed.

english: Airports nationwide were placed on high alert with intensified screenings following a classified security memo.
ekegusii: Ebitii biechindeke Kenya engima mbiabiaboretigwe koba maiso na komongera buya baria bonsi bagosoa ase ebitii ebio korengana nogokurerwa kwa ime kwarwetwe nabarendi boborendi.
kiswahili: Viwanja vya ndege kote nchini vimewekwa katika tahadhari kubwa huku uchunguzi ukiimarishwa kufuatia taarifa ya usalama iliyofichwa.
dholuo: E pinje duto, ne oket ndege e bwo rit maduong' kendo ne oket chenro mar nono weche mag sirkal.
somali: Garoomada diyaaradaha ee dalka oo dhan waxaa si taxadar leh loo baaray iyadoo la raacayo tallaabooyinka amniga.

english: Security agencies increased nationwide patrols during the festive season to deter crime and safeguard communities.
ekegusii: Abatenereri boborendi bagesire obomongeri bwabo Kenya engima chingaki chiotimoko nemeyega ao ao gotanga obokebago eri korenda ebinyoro.
kiswahili: Mashirika ya usalama yaliongeza doria za kitaifa wakati wa msimu wa sikukuu ili kuzuia uhalifu na kulinda jamii.
dholuo: Sirkal ne medo timo tij lendo e piny mangima e kinde mag nyasi mondo gimi ji kik tim timbe mahundu kendo girit oganda.
somali: Hay'adaha amniga ayaa kordhiyay safarada dalka oo dhan xilliyada xafladaha si looga hortago dambiyada loona ilaaliyo bulshada.

english: Authorities notified the public of an Al-Shabaab attack in Garissa and urged vigilance as additional troops were deployed.
ekegusii: Aabarai banyirie abanainchi igoro yobkebago bwogokwa epomu na Al-Shabaab aaria garisa Garissa na gosaba koba maiso buna enchera eyemo gokonya ebikosi bia abasikari biria biatomirwe.
kiswahili: Mamlaka iliwaarifu umma kuhusu shambulio la Al-Shabaab huko Garissa na kuhimiza kuwa macho huku wanajeshi wengine wakipelekwa.
dholuo: Sirkal ne onyiso ji ni Al-Shabaab ne omonjo Garissa kendo ne gikwayo ji mondo obed motang' nikech ne omed jolweny mamoko.
somali: Saraakiisha ayaa shacabka ka warbixiyay weerarkii Al-shabaab ay ku qaadeen magaalada Garissa, waxayna ku baaqeen inay ka taxaddaraan ciidamo badan oo la adeegsaday.

english: Missing Voices documented a sharp rise in enforced disappearances and killings linked to protests, urging justice for families of missing victims.
ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Missing Voices mbarigete igoro yokomenteka kwabanto gosira gose gokenganigwa, and goitwa ase engencho yokorobererekana kwanga oborai obobe, na gosaba ng'a ekeeneo gekoreke ase abanto bakenganirie gose kobiswa ase engencho yokorobererekana.
kiswahili: Missing Voices ilirekodi ongezeko kubwa la kutoweka kwa watu na mauaji yaliyohusishwa na maandamano, ikihimiza haki kwa familia za waathiriwa waliopotea.
dholuo: Missing Voices ne onyiso ni kwan mar joma ne onegi gi thuologi duto kod joma ne onegi ne medore ahinya nikech ne gineno ni onge gima ne dhi timore ne joodgi ma ne olal.
somali: Codadka la waayay waxay muujinayeen koror aad u weyn oo ku yimid khasaaraha iyo dilka ka dhashay banaanbaxyada, iyagoo codsaday caddaalad qoysaska dhibanayaasha la waayay.

english: Local media reported calls for prosecution of officers accused of excessive force during Gen Z protests, urging IPOA and ODPP action.
ekegusii: Chisiteseni chai aiga inka chiokomnyia amang'ana nchiatebete konyora chisimi chikogosereri kobabwata na kopbasoera ase ogotangasa abasikari baria basoeretwe gotumia chinguru goetania ekero giokorobererekana chingaki chia Gen Z, na bakarigia ogokonya korwa IPOA na ODPP.
kiswahili: Vyombo vya habari vya ndani viliripoti wito wa kushtakiwa kwa maafisa walioshutumiwa kwa kutumia nguvu kupita kiasi wakati wa maandamano ya Gen Z, wakihimiza hatua za IPOA na ODPP.
dholuo: Oganda mar Jo-Kenya ne oketo chenro mar keto ketho kuom jotelo ma ne odonjne ni ne otiyo gi teko mokalo tong' e kinde mar ng'ur mar Gen Z, kendo ne gikwayo mondo otim gima biro miyo otim kamano.
somali: Warbaahinta maxalliga ah ayaa sheegtay inay doonayaan inay dacweeyaan saraakiisha booliska ee lagu eedeeyay inay adeegsadeen xoog xoog badan intii lagu jiray banaanbaxyada Gen Z, iyagoo ku booriyay IPOA iyo ODP inay talaabo qaadaan.

english: An academic analysis linked protest-related abuses to systemic police impunity rooted in historical failures of accountability.
ekegusii: Amasomo yokongori igoro yabasikari kobuna amahiko ekero giokorobererekana kobwataine nagotakorerwa ekero kwamochire ase obokoreri bwabasikari bwairire emeri ase eiaka emenge yogotakorerwa kende ekero bamochire.
kiswahili: Uchambuzi wa kitaaluma ulihusisha unyanyasaji unaohusiana na maandamano na kutokujali kwa polisi kwa utaratibu uliotokana na kushindwa kwa uwajibikaji wa kihistoria.
dholuo: Nonro moro mar josomo ne oketo tudruok e kind timbe maricho ma ne timore e kind joma ne kedo gi sirkal kod timbe maok kare ma ne timorega e kind polise nikech ne ok ginyal chiwo dwoko.
somali: Falanqaynta aqoonyahanku waxay isku dartay falalka diidmada ah ee ka dhanka ah booliska nidaamka sharciga oo aan la ciqaabin xadgudubyada taariikhiga ah ee mas'uuliyadda.

english: Missing Voices published a registry of killings and disappearances among youth during Gen Z protests, calling for formal investigations.
ekegusii: Abariki amang'ana ba Missing Voices mbarigete buna abasae bare goitwa, gokenganigwa gose kobiswa ekero giokorobererekana kwa Gen Z, na koboria ng'a obotuki bwakeene bokorwe.
kiswahili: Missing Voices ilichapisha sajili ya mauaji na kutoweka kwa vijana wakati wa maandamano ya Gen Z, ikitaka uchunguzi rasmi ufanyike.
dholuo: Missing Voices ne ogolo buk manyiso kaka ne oneg rowere kod kaka ne githung' e kind rowere e kinde mag ng'ur mar Gen Z, kendo ne okwayo mondo otim nonro.
somali: Codadka lumay waxay daabaceen liiska dilka iyo la'aanta dhalinyarada ka dhacay mudaaharaadyada Gen Z, waxayna dalbadeen baaritaan rasmi ah.

english: JLTM NGO documented over 500 protest-related arrests, urging release of minors and access to legal representation.
ekegusii: JLTM NGO mbarigete goetania abanto500 abarobererekani babwatetwe, na kobori ng'a babwatokwe ara rimo na mono abana abake na baegwe oborongo bwokoegererwa kemachiko.
kiswahili: Shirika lisilo la kiserikali la JLTM lilirekodi zaidi ya watu 500 waliokamatwa kuhusiana na maandamano, likihimiza kuachiliwa kwa watoto na kupata uwakilishi wa kisheria.
dholuo: JLTM NGO ne ondiko weche mokalo 500 motudore gi makruok gi ji, ka gikwayo ni ogony nyithindo matindo kendo mondo giyud thuolo mar bedo e bwo chik.
somali: Hay'adda JLTM NGO waxay xasuusisay in ka badan 500 oo mudaaharaadayaal ah la xiray, waxayna ku baaqday in carruurta yaryar la sii daayo iyo in la helo wakiil sharci.

english: Civil society organized silent vigils in Nairobi to honor protest victims and call for justice across diverse communities.
ekegusii: Omoroberio bwobomo bwebiombe bitari bieserikari okaroberia ogekengano aaria Nairobi koinyora baria baria bakwete na gokorerwa bobe na koboria ng'a ekeene ase abarobererekani gokoreke ase abanto bonsi Kenya engima.
kiswahili: Asasi za kiraia ziliandaa mikesha ya kimya kimya jijini Nairobi ili kuwaenzi waathiriwa wa maandamano na kutaka haki itendeke katika jamii mbalimbali.
dholuo: Jo-dhano ne ochano mondo otim nyasi mar rito ji e Nairobi mondo gipakgo joma ne oketho nikech gik ma ne gitimo kendo ne gikwayo ni mondo ji otimnegi makare e kindgi giwegi.
somali: Bulshada rayidka ah waxay magaalada Nairobi ku qabanqaabisay cibaadooyin aamusnaan ah si ay u ixtiraamaan dhibanayaasha mudaaharaadyada iyo inay codsadaan caddaaladda bulshada.

english: Government sought public input on using artificial intelligence and new technologies to strengthen prevention of violent extremism and address rising online recruitment risks.
ekegusii: Eserikari nyarigetie amaoni korwa abanainchi igoro yogotumia akiri pandia na tekinorochia enyia gokongia gotanga obokebago bwokoruta chipomu na gokwanera igoro yemechando yogosoigwa goetera eintaneti.
kiswahili: Serikali ilitafuta maoni ya umma kuhusu kutumia akili bandia na teknolojia mpya ili kuimarisha kuzuia itikadi kali na kushughulikia hatari zinazoongezeka za kuajiri watu mtandaoni.
dholuo: Sirkal ne okwayo ji mondo ochiw paro e wi tiyo gi rieko mar loso gik moko kod teknoloji manyien mondo omi ji omed geng'o timbe mahundu kendo mondo gitiek chandruoge ma yudo ji e intanet.
somali: Dowladdu waxay raadineysay aragtida dadweynaha ee ku saabsan isticmaalka sirdoonka macmalka ah iyo tikniyoolajiyada cusub si loo xoojiyo ka hortagga siyaasadda adag iyo wax ka qabashada khataraha internetka.

english: Journalists from multiple counties trained on responsible reporting of violent extremism to prevent sensationalism and reduce harm.
ekegusii: Abariki amangana korwa chinse ao ao mbaegeretie igoro yokorika na komanyia goetra amangana ase enchera engikeranu igoro yogosarigwa ebirengererio buna enchera eyemo yogotanga ogosarigwa obongo amangana echinkuma, okogosia gose okongainereria erio gotanga ogosareka kwa'bange.
kiswahili: Waandishi wa habari kutoka kaunti nyingi walipata mafunzo kuhusu kuripoti kwa uwajibikaji kuhusu itikadi kali za kikatili ili kuzuia uchochezi na kupunguza madhara.
dholuo: Jofwamb weche moa e pinje mang'eny ne otieg mondo kik gibed gi timbe mahundu kendo mondo kik giketh gik ma timore.
somali: Warbaahinta badankoodu waxay barteen inay ka warbixiyaan rabshadaha diinta si ay u yareeyaan xiisaha iyo waxyeelada.

english: Terrorist attacks are more likely during major holidays and the public is urged to maintain heightened awareness and avoid crowded spaces.
ekegusii: Ogoakwa chipomu ngokageire mono chingaki chiemetiko nemeyega emenene igo ogosaba goikarania koba maiso kwarurwe goetra okomanyania na kwebacha korwa omoganda bwabanto abange.
kiswahili: Mashambulizi ya kigaidi yana uwezekano mkubwa wa kutokea wakati wa sikukuu kuu na umma unahimizwa kudumisha uelewa mkubwa na kuepuka nafasi zilizojaa watu.
dholuo: Thoth ji nyalo timo timbe mahundu e kinde mag nyasi madongo kendo ijiwo ji mondo obed motang' gi pek mag ngima kendo kik gibed gi kuonde ma ji ng'enyie.
somali: Weerarrada argagixisadu waxay u badan yihiin xilliyada ciidaha waaweyn, dadkana waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay ka fogaadaan meelaha dadku ka buuxaan.

english: Kenya hosts regional training to strengthen capacity in combating terrorism financing with participation from experts across Africa.
ekegusii: Kenya yaretire amo okwegerigwa kwa abarai bechingongo gokongia okobua kwabo korwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu na baria bakorwa chibesa gokora ayio ase ogasanga nabimanyi korwa Afrika engima.
kiswahili: Kenya inaandaa mafunzo ya kikanda ili kuimarisha uwezo katika kupambana na ufadhili wa ugaidi kwa kushirikisha wataalamu kote Afrika.
dholuo: Kenya timo tiegruok e pinje mag Afrika mondo omed jiwo nyalo mar kedo gi pesa ma itiyogo e chulo tuke mag mahundu.
somali: Kenya waxay leedahay tababar gobol ah oo lagu xoojinayo awoodda ka hortagga kharashka argagixisada iyada oo la kaashanayo khubarada Afrika oo dhan.

english: An annual analysis reviews terrorism trends and advises residents and travelers on safety.
ekegusii: Okorigereria gwa kera omwaka bunayeboba bikoruta chipomu gwasemirie abamenyi na baria bakogenda chisafari berende.
kiswahili: Uchambuzi wa kila mwaka hupitia mitindo ya ugaidi na kuwashauri wakazi na wasafiri kuhusu usalama.
dholuo: Nonro ma itimo higa ka higa nono kaka timbe mahundu chalo kendo konyo joma odak e alworano kod joma wuotho e yor ritruok.
somali: Baadhitaannada sanadlaha ah waxay falanqeeyaan rabshadaha argagixisada waxayna la talinayaan dadka deggan iyo dadka safarka ah amniga.

english: Message encouraging citizens to recognize and report suspicious behavior noting that vigilance strengthens community security.
ekegusii: Amangana amenge esimi koa abanainchi emioyo buna bakomanya na korwa eripot igoro yebikoru biechitangutangu bamanyete buya ng'a koba maiso nenchera eyemo yogokongia oborendi bwebinyoro.
kiswahili: Ujumbe unaowahimiza raia kutambua na kuripoti tabia za kutiliwa shaka ukibainisha kuwa uangalifu huimarisha usalama wa jamii.
dholuo: Sirkal jiwo raia mondo ohul timbe ma ok kare, ka owacho ni rito ji miyo sirkal bedo gi rit maber.
somali: Fariin ku dhiirigelinaya muwaadiniinta inay aqoonsadaan oo ay soo sheegaan dabeecadaha shakiga leh iyagoo xusuusanaya in taxadarku uu xoojiyo nabadgelyada bulshada.

english: Outline of four steps to enhance digital safety and strengthen national security online.
ekegusii: Omoroberio bwebinto bine ebikeranu gokong'ia oborendi bwedichitari na gokong'ia oborendi bwense ase eintaneti.
kiswahili: Muhtasari wa hatua nne za kuimarisha usalama wa kidijitali na kuimarisha usalama wa taifa mtandaoni.
dholuo: Weche ang'wen ma biro konyo e medo ritruok e yore mag digital kod ritruok mar piny mangima e Intanet.
somali: Sawirka afar tallaabo oo lagu hagaajinayo amniga dijitaalka ah iyo xoojinta amniga qaranka ee internetka.

english: Kenya's strategy to curb radicalization and prevent violent extremism through community engagement and multi agency responses.
ekegusii: Emeroberio ya Kenya gokora ogosarigwa obongo namang'ana yebibago na gotanga ogoakwa chipomugoetera okobwaterana nebinyoro nebitengo ao ao bieserikari goikerania ayio.
kiswahili: Mkakati wa Kenya wa kupunguza itikadi kali na kuzuia itikadi kali kupitia ushiriki wa jamii na majibu ya mashirika mengi.
dholuo: Chenro mar Kenya mar geng'o ji mondo kik gibed gi timbe mahundu kendo geng'o timbe mahundu kokalo kuom riwruok mar oganda koda riwruok mopogore opogore.
somali: Kenya Bradtons waxay leedahay istaraatijiyad ay ku hortagto isbeddelka siyaasadeed ee weyn iyo ka hortagga rabshadaha rabshadaha iyada oo loo marayo rabshadaha bulshada iyo falcelinta ururada badankood.

english: Kenya launches curriculum enabling officers to identify and counter extremism.
ekegusii: Kenya yaansire amasomo gokonya abarai komanya na gotanga obokebago bwogosaria ebirengererio.
kiswahili: Kenya yazindua mtaala unaowawezesha maafisa kutambua na kukabiliana na itikadi kali.
dholuo: Kenya chako chenro mar somo ma miyo jotelo nyalo fwenyo kendo kedo gi timbe mahundu.
somali: Kenya waxay bilaabaneysaa waxbarasho u oggolaanaysa saraakiisha inay aqoonsadaan diimaha adag oo ay diidaan.

english: Parliament strengthens anti money laundering and counter terrorism financing frameworks.
ekegusii: Bunge yakongirie okorosia chipesa chia pandia na gokinana nobokebago bwokoruta chipomu na baria bakobaa chibesa gokora obokebago obwo.
kiswahili: Bunge laimarisha mifumo ya kupambana na utakatishaji fedha haramu na kupambana na ugaidi.
dholuo: ATPU timo tij geng'o gik ma kelo hinyruok, chiwo paro, koda tije mag riwruoge mang'eny.
somali: Baarlamaanku wuxuu xoojiyaa qorshaha ka hortagga isticmaalka lacagta iyo ka hortagga argagixisada.

english: Corruption threatens security and growth. Report unethical conduct to safeguard public resources.
ekegusii: Obokengeka nokokosia ase aborendo namagenderero. Karwe eripoti yebikoru ore nechitangutangu gose ogokora gotabwenereti gochia ase abarai korena obonda bwebinyoro na Kenya.
kiswahili: Rushwa inatishia usalama na ukuaji. Ripoti mwenendo usio wa kimaadili ili kulinda rasilimali za umma.
dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda Jehova biro miyo ji duto obed gi winjruok maber gi Nyasaye.
somali: Musuqmaasuqku wuxuu khatar ku yahay ammaanka iyo horumarka.

english: Know your rights and demand integrity from public officials to reduce corruption risks.
ekegusii: Manya oboronge bwa na boria ng'a abakoreri beserikari babe abeene ase emeremo yabo gokeania obokengeka.
kiswahili: Jua haki zako na udai uadilifu kutoka kwa maafisa wa umma ili kupunguza hatari za ufisadi.
dholuo: Ng'e ratiro ma in-go kendo iket chik mondo jotich sirkal obed joma ler mondo okonygi giduok chien rach ma giyudo nikech mibadhi.
somali: Ogsoonow xuquuqdaada oo codso daacadnimada saraakiisha dawladda si loo yareeyo khatarta musuqmaasuqa.

english: Civil society networks across Africa push for transparency. Support governance-strengthening efforts.
ekegusii: Okobwaterana kwebiombe bitari bieserikari Africa engima mbagendererete gosuguma obomaiso marore ase obokoreri. Sira emeroberio eye egokongia obogambi obuya.
kiswahili: Mitandao ya asasi za kiraia kote Afrika inasukuma uwazi. Saidia juhudi za kuimarisha utawala.
dholuo: Oganda mar oganda dhano e Afrika duto jiwo weche duto ma nyiso ni gidwaro bedo gi mibadhi.
somali: Shabakadaha bulshada ee Afrika oo dhan waxay ku adkeysanayaan caddeynta.

english: A new justice sector framework was introduced to unify anti‑corruption efforts.
ekegusii: Amaonchorerio ime yeserikari ase obokoreri bwamachiko arengete chikoti naansetwe koreta amo okorwania obokengeka.
kiswahili: Mfumo mpya wa sekta ya haki ulianzishwa ili kuunganisha juhudi za kupambana na ufisadi.
dholuo: Ne oket chenro manyien mar weche mag bura mondo oriw kinda mitimo e kedo gi mibadhi.
somali: Nidaam caddaalad ah oo cusub ayaa la aasaasay si loo mideeyo dadaallada la dagaalanka musuqmaasuqa.

english: Recent prosecutions of officials show commitment to tackling economic crimes.
ekegusii: Okonacherwa ekina kwa abaofisa bwango iga nekiorokererio giesirikari korwania obosaria bwobogoko bwense.
kiswahili: Mashtaka ya hivi karibuni dhidi ya maafisa yanaonyesha kujitolea kwao kukabiliana na uhalifu wa kiuchumi.
dholuo: Timbego ma nyocha otim ne jotelo nyiso ni gigeno ahinya tieko timbe mahundu.
somali: Dacwaddii ugu dambeysay ee mas'uuliyiintu soo jeediyeen waxay muujinayaan mas'uuliyadda ay u leeyihiin in la joojiyo dambiyada dhaqaale.

english: A bill proposes a 10‑year procurement ban for individuals and firms convicted of corruption.
ekegusii: Richiko riyia igoro yobogori bwobokengeka riabekire ogotangwa emiaka 10 korwa obogori ae abagoribakonyorekana koba abogori bakengeka.
kiswahili: Muswada unapendekeza marufuku ya miaka 10 ya ununuzi kwa watu binafsi na makampuni yaliyopatikana na hatia ya ufisadi.
dholuo: Bill moro otemo keto mar higini apar marfuk mar nyiewo gik moko ne ji koda ne ohala ma ne oyang' gi ketho mar mibadhi.
somali: Sharcigu wuxuu soo jeedinayaa in 10 sano la mamnuuco shaqsiyaadka iyo shirkadaha lagu xukumay musuqmaasuq.
